# Mannagum

> Mannagum is a comprehensive resource for sustainable building practices, eco-friendly materials, and DIY woodworking using recycled and FSC-certified wood.

The site specializes in sustainable construction and design with a focus on recycled wood, green building materials, and environmentally responsible building practices. It serves both professionals and DIY enthusiasts interested in eco-construction and interior design.

## Key Topics

- FSC certification
- Recycled wood
- Sustainable flooring
- Eco-construction
- Forest Stewardship Council
- Green building
- Timber sourcing
- Reclaimed wood
- Bamboo
- Cork
- VOCs
- Interior design
- Upcycling
- Sustainable crafts
- Environmental responsibility

## Sustainable Building & Materials

- [Eco Construction & Design: Sustainable Building with Recycled Wood](https://mannagum.net): Homepage for sustainable building with FSC-certified recycled wood and eco-friendly materials

## DIY Woodworking & Upcycling

- [DIY Woodworking Guide: Beginner Sustainable Crafts and Upcycling](https://mannagum.net/page/3): DIY woodworking guide for beginner sustainable crafts and upcycling projects

## Optional Resources

- [Mobile App Development Guide](https://mannagum.net/page/2): Mobile app development guide covering Java, Swift, Kotlin, and cross-platform design
